title: Aries Image Studio
description: Jobs, queue, cards and stages from Studio's /metrics; GPU host vitals from node_exporter hwmon; wall power and time-of-use cost from a metering smart plug.

list.name: tariff_price_base
list.label: Price per kWh outside the windows

panels.title: GPU Agents
panels.description: Connectivity status of GPU agents over gRPC.

panels.title: Running Jobs
panels.description: Image generation jobs currently executing on cards.

panels.title: Waiting in Queue
panels.description: Submitted jobs waiting for GPU cards to pick them up.

panels.title: Done in Range
panels.description: Jobs completed within the selected time window (restart-resilient via increase).

panels.title: Failures in Range
panels.description: Stage attempts that failed in the viewed range (including retries).

panels.title: Host RAM Available
panels.description: Lowest available system memory on the GPU host. Red under 4 GiB floor; yellow under 6 GiB decode threshold.

panels.title: GPU temperature
panels.description: Package temperature of each card (xe hwmon). The driver reports 100 °C as critical.

panels.title: VRAM temperature
panels.description: Memory temperature of each card; the driver reports 105 °C as critical.

panels.title: GPU fan
panels.description: Fan speed of each card. 0 at idle is normal (the fan stops when cool).

panels.title: GPU power (hwmon)
panels.description: Board power of each card, from its energy counter (~200 W each at full load).

panels.title: GPU temperature vs load
panels.description: Package, VRAM, memory controller and PCIe temperatures per card. Dashed critical limits: 100 °C = pkg/mctrl, 105 °C = VRAM critical. Shaded: when each card was busy (right axis).

targets.expr: label_replace(aries_executor_state{state="busy",agent=~"$agent"} * on (agent, executor) group_left (device) max by (agent, executor, device) (aries_executor_mem_total_bytes{agent=~"$agent"}), "card", "$1", "device", "0000:(.*)")

panels.title: Fans vs load
panels.description: Each card's fan, plus any other fans the host reports; shaded: when each card was busy (right axis).

targets.expr: label_replace(aries_executor_state{state="busy",agent=~"$agent"} * on (agent, executor) group_left (device) max by (agent, executor, device) (aries_executor_mem_total_bytes{agent=~"$agent"}), "card", "$1", "device", "0000:(.*)")

panels.title: GPU power vs load
panels.description: Board power per card; shaded: when each card was busy (right axis).

targets.expr: label_replace(aries_executor_state{state="busy",agent=~"$agent"} * on (agent, executor) group_left (device) max by (agent, executor, device) (aries_executor_mem_total_bytes{agent=~"$agent"}), "card", "$1", "device", "0000:(.*)")

panels.title: Host temperatures
panels.description: CPU package and NVMe temperatures on the GPU host. Dashed critical line at 95 °C.

panels.title: Host CPU and memory
panels.description: CPU busy share and memory in use on the GPU host.

panels.title: Wall power
panels.description: Whole GPU host at the wall, from a metering smart plug ($wall_power_metric).

panels.title: GPU power (hwmon)
panels.description: Total board power of all cards.

panels.title: Energy in range
panels.description: Energy used by the GPU host in the viewed range (the plug's energy counter).

panels.title: Cost in range (${energy_currency})
panels.description: Each minute's energy × the tariff price then in effect. Price per kWh is tariff_price_base, or tariff_price_1 / tariff_price_2 between their start and end hours (local time in tariff_timezone; windows do not cross midnight). These are dashboard constants, 0 until set. Needs VictoriaMetrics (MetricsQL timezone_offset).

targets.expr: sum_over_time((sum(increase($wall_energy_wh_metric{$wall_plug_selector}[1m])) / 1000 * ($tariff_price_base + ($tariff_price_1 - $tariff_price_base) * ((floor(((time() + timezone_offset("$tariff_timezone")) % 86400) / 3600) >= bool $tariff_start_1) * (floor(((time() + timezone_offset("$tariff_timezone")) % 86400) / 3600) < bool $tariff_end_1)) + ($tariff_price_2 - $tariff_price_base) * ((floor(((time() + timezone_offset("$tariff_timezone")) % 86400) / 3600) >= bool $tariff_start_2) * (floor(((time() + timezone_offset("$tariff_timezone")) % 86400) / 3600) < bool $tariff_end_2))))[$__range:1m])

panels.title: Energy per image
panels.description: Wall energy in range ÷ jobs finished in range. Idle time counts too.

panels.title: Cost per image (${energy_currency})
panels.description: Cost in range ÷ jobs finished in range. Price per kWh is tariff_price_base, or tariff_price_1 / tariff_price_2 between their start and end hours (local time in tariff_timezone; windows do not cross midnight). These are dashboard constants, 0 until set. Needs VictoriaMetrics (MetricsQL timezone_offset).

targets.expr: sum_over_time((sum(increase($wall_energy_wh_metric{$wall_plug_selector}[1m])) / 1000 * ($tariff_price_base + ($tariff_price_1 - $tariff_price_base) * ((floor(((time() + timezone_offset("$tariff_timezone")) % 86400) / 3600) >= bool $tariff_start_1) * (floor(((time() + timezone_offset("$tariff_timezone")) % 86400) / 3600) < bool $tariff_end_1)) + ($tariff_price_2 - $tariff_price_base) * ((floor(((time() + timezone_offset("$tariff_timezone")) % 86400) / 3600) >= bool $tariff_start_2) * (floor(((time() + timezone_offset("$tariff_timezone")) % 86400) / 3600) < bool $tariff_end_2))))[$__range:1m]) / (sum(increase(aries_job_e2e_seconds_count[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Wall power vs GPUs, with tariff
panels.description: Whole box at the wall vs all cards' board power, and the rest of the host (wall − cards). Orange step line (right axis): the tariff price in effect. Price per kWh is tariff_price_base, or tariff_price_1 / tariff_price_2 between their start and end hours (local time in tariff_timezone; windows do not cross midnight). These are dashboard constants, 0 until set. Needs VictoriaMetrics (MetricsQL timezone_offset).

targets.expr: ($tariff_price_base + ($tariff_price_1 - $tariff_price_base) * ((floor(((time() + timezone_offset("$tariff_timezone")) % 86400) / 3600) >= bool $tariff_start_1) * (floor(((time() + timezone_offset("$tariff_timezone")) % 86400) / 3600) < bool $tariff_end_1)) + ($tariff_price_2 - $tariff_price_base) * ((floor(((time() + timezone_offset("$tariff_timezone")) % 86400) / 3600) >= bool $tariff_start_2) * (floor(((time() + timezone_offset("$tariff_timezone")) % 86400) / 3600) < bool $tariff_end_2)))

panels.title: Energy per interval
panels.description: kWh used in each interval of the viewed range.

panels.title: Jobs in flight
panels.description: Jobs waiting and running.

panels.title: Queued tasks by stage
panels.description: Tasks waiting per stage (enhance, encode, denoise, decode).

panels.title: Why tasks wait
panels.description: Blocked tasks by the reason the scheduler gives (the same text the web app shows on a waiting job).

panels.title: Jobs finished per hour
panels.description: Completed jobs by output size.

panels.title: Job time, submit to done
panels.description: Mean end-to-end time by output size and whether the enhancer ran, over 30 minutes.

targets.expr: sum by (size, enhanced) (rate(aries_job_e2e_seconds_sum[30m])) / sum by (size, enhanced) (rate(aries_job_e2e_seconds_count[30m]))

panels.title: Queue wait by stage
panels.description: Mean time a task spent queued before a card took it, over 15 minutes.

panels.title: Card state
panels.description: What each card's executor is doing: idle (no worker), starting (loading a model), ready (model loaded, no task), busy, stopping, failed.

targets.expr: 1 * sum by (agent, executor) (aries_executor_state{state="starting",agent=~"$agent"}) + 2 * sum by (agent, executor) (aries_executor_state{state="ready",agent=~"$agent"}) + 3 * sum by (agent, executor) (aries_executor_state{state="busy",agent=~"$agent"}) + 4 * sum by (agent, executor) (aries_executor_state{state="stopping",agent=~"$agent"}) + 5 * sum by (agent, executor) (aries_executor_state{state="failed",agent=~"$agent"})

panels.title: VRAM in use
panels.description: Used share of each card's memory, as the agent reads it.

panels.title: VRAM used
panels.description: Bytes in use on each card over time; dashed line at the card's total.

panels.title: Driver overflow into host RAM
panels.description: GPU memory the driver spilled into system RAM (fdinfo). Should be near zero; growth here preceded the OOM kills in HARDWARE.md.

panels.title: Host RAM available
panels.description: Available RAM on the GPU host. Lines at the 4 GiB RAM-guard floor and the 6 GiB an untiled decode above 3.5 MP needs.

panels.title: Stage time (mean)
panels.description: Mean task time per stage over 15 minutes. Denoise depends on size and steps.

panels.title: Stage time (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile over 1 hour. Needs an agent with the wider histogram buckets (up to 30 min); older agents put everything over 10 s in one bucket.

panels.title: Model load time (mean)
panels.description: Time a stage worker takes to load its model onto a card, over 30 minutes.

targets.expr: sum by (stage, model) (rate(aries_worker_load_seconds_sum{agent=~"$agent"}[30m])) / sum by (stage, model) (rate(aries_worker_load_seconds_count{agent=~"$agent"}[30m]))

panels.title: Model switches
panels.description: A card changing stage means stopping one worker and loading another model. Many switches mean time lost to loading.

panels.title: Model load time by card (mean)
panels.description: Time each card takes to load each model, over 30 minutes.

targets.expr: sum by (executor, model) (rate(aries_worker_load_seconds_sum{agent=~"$agent"}[30m])) / sum by (executor, model) (rate(aries_worker_load_seconds_count{agent=~"$agent"}[30m]))

panels.title: Task failures by class
panels.description: Failed stage attempts by the agent's crash classification.

panels.title: Worker exits and RAM-guard kills
panels.description: Stage worker exits other than clean stops, and workers killed by the RAM guard.

panels.title: Agent metrics scrape age
panels.description: Seconds since Studio last read each agent's /metrics (about 1 s when healthy; lines at 5 s and 15 s).

panels.title: Studio CPU (cores)
panels.description: CPU used by the Studio container (cAdvisor).

panels.title: Studio memory working set
panels.description: Studio container working set, and its memory limit (kube-state-metrics).

panels.title: Studio data volume
panels.description: Used share of Studio's data volume (kubelet volume stats).
